name: askpass
resume: Both exports of askpass 1.2.1 are done. A non-interactive session returns None. An interactive prompt uses getpass. Linux has no bundled helper, so ssh_askpass is None. There is no crate.

functions.name: askpass
functions.done: Ask for a password. Non-interactive sessions return None.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(askpass))
one <- function() {
  is.null(askpass("x"))
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
shown <- enc2utf8(paste(as.character(value), collapse = "|"))
cat("VALUE ", shown, "\n", sep = "")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import time
import askpass as ask
ask.options['rlib_interactive'] = False

def one():
        return "TRUE" if ask.askpass("x") is None else "FALSE"

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
    shown = "|".join("" if item is None else str(item) for item in value)
elif value is None:
    shown = "NULL"
else:
    shown = str(value)
print("VALUE " + shown)
print(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}")
